meta: Concept site for Lantern Row Barbershop, a made-up Long Beach, California barbershop: classic cuts, skin fades and hot towel shaves, booked online. Designed by shash.builds.

hero.title: Sharp cuts. Hot towels. No rush.
hero.sub: Classic cuts, skin fades and straight-razor shaves in a quiet shop on the east side of Long Beach. Book your chair online in under a minute.
facts: Walk-ins when a chair is free

menu.title: Cuts and shaves.
menu.note: Sample prices for this concept. On a live site, the shop sets them.
items: Scissor or clipper, washed and styled. 30 minutes.
Bald to blended, finished with a straight-razor line-up.
Full haircut plus a beard shape and hot towel.
Two hot towels, a straight razor and a cold finish.

steps: See every open chair for the week and choose the one that fits.
A text the day before. Running late? Reply and we'll shuffle.
Hot towel, a cut that takes the time it needs, and you're out the door.

hero.alt: A red, white and blue barber pole mounted on an old brick wall at dusk.

g1.alt: A straight razor, a shaving brush and a cake of shaving soap on a light table.

area.title: Easy to reach from all over Long Beach.
area.note: Street parking out front, and a short walk from the bus line.

about.title: A barbershop that runs on time.
body: Most shops overbook, so you wait forty minutes and then get a rushed cut. We book every chair with room to breathe.
Your barber has the time to ask what you want, do it properly and finish with a hot towel. Then you're on with your day.

promise.title: Not happy with the cut? Come back within 7 days.
promise.body: We'll fix it, free. Just book a quick touch-up and tell your barber what's off.

faq: Yes, when a chair is free. Booking online is the only way to skip the wait.
How long does a cut take?
About 30 minutes for a cut, 45 for a skin fade and an hour for a cut and beard.
Do you cut curly and textured hair?
Yes. Every barber in the shop cuts all hair types.
Can I book for my kid?
Yes. Kids' cuts are for 12 and under, and you can book two chairs back to back.
Metered street parking out front, free after 6pm and on Sundays.

form.title: Book your chair.
form.note: Pick what you want and when. We'll text to confirm your time.
